recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中巨噬細胞的細胞質內吞入多個有核細胞與紅血球（hemophagocytosis）；骨髓切片以組織球標記（如 CD163）染色，可見大量陽性組織球散布，部分內含被吞噬的細胞，符合噬血性淋巴組織球增生症（HLH）。
features: Panel A (BM aspirate): activated macrophages with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm containing several engulfed nucleated cells (likely erythroid precursors/lymphocytes) and red cells
Phagocytosed cells appear as dark round nuclei within clear phagocytic vacuoles
Macrophage nucleus eccentric and compressed by ingested material
Panel B (BM biopsy IHC, likely CD163): markedly increased brown-staining interstitial histiocytes with dendritic processes, some enlarged with phagocytosed cells
Background marrow with fat spaces and mixed hematopoietic cells
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows activated macrophages whose cytoplasm contains multiple engulfed nucleated hematopoietic cells and red cells within phagocytic vacuoles. Immunohistochemistry for a histiocytic marker (likely CD163) on the core biopsy highlights a markedly increased population of interstitial histiocytes, several of which are enlarged and contain phagocytosed cells. Hemophagocytosis itself is neither sensitive nor specific; findings are consistent with hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis in the appropriate clinical and laboratory context (HLH-2004 criteria, including fever, cytopenias, hyperferritinemia, hypertriglyceridemia/hypofibrinogenemia, elevated sIL-2R and low NK activity).

ddx.vs: Isolated hemophagocytic macrophages are common after transfusion or infection and do not constitute HLH without the clinical and laboratory criteria.
Histiocytic sarcoma shows cytologically malignant histiocytes with nuclear atypia and mitoses forming sheets, rather than bland activated macrophages.
Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes are S100 positive and show intact lymphocytes passing through cytoplasm (emperipolesis) without destruction, usually in lymph nodes.
Morphology of the macrophages is identical; an underlying T/NK or EBV-positive lymphoma must be sought with IHC, EBER and clonality studies.
